newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close steady with buying and selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close steady with buying and selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed mostly steady on lower volume, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 0.53 points or 0.05 percent at 1,047.8 on a turnover of 39.3 million taka on Wednesday. Losers led gainers by 67 to 46.
Brokers said some of the blue chips gained as they were attractive after their recent fall. "The retail investors were cautious in making fresh commitments," said one broker.

Brokers referred to the reported resignation of the Securities and Exchange Commission chief. Harunur Rashid said on Wednesday that he had submitted a resignation letter. But the government has yet to accept his resignation.

"I don't think the market would react adversely. The market sentiment is already depressed because of lingering bearish trend since a price manipulation scandal rocked the market late last year," a broker said.
He said the investors suffered fund constraints due to a sharp fall of share prices over the past several months. The investors are also under pressure to repay bank loans taken against their shares.
Beximco Pharma gained 1.31 taka to 132.62, Bata Shoe lost 0.46 to 124 and Chittagong Cement was up 31.57 to 1,837.62.
